title: The same grant on a sequence that backs a serial insert path

expect.note: reported with the column it feeds, which is what turns the advice from `REVOKE` into `AS IDENTITY`: a `serial` column cannot be written by any role without USAGE on its sequence

fix: Establish whether corpus_anon writes c_seq_serial.tickets before touching this grant — a `serial` column cannot be inserted without USAGE on its sequence, so a revoke on the wrong assumption breaks the write path rather than closing a hole. Converting the column to `GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY` removes the need for any grant on the sequence, which is the fix that does not trade one break for another.
